scope: Execution-only optimization of the frozen v11 candidate; no training, new architecture or test-based model selection
precision: FP32 neural core, FP64 phases/covariance/MVDR; no TF32 or quantization
primary_timing: User-requested total time for all 12000 test scenes processed sequentially at batch size 1, divided by 12000. CUDA synchronize at whole-loop boundaries. Includes fresh graph input copies and storage of every output weight; GPU inputs resident.
supplemental_timing: Same AOA/mask provided on CPU and complex weights returned to CPU, including transfers
primary_comparison: Latest user instruction: optimize our network; standard MVDR closed-form covariance/solve/normalize and standard original-form DNNABF forward are primary references. Report implementation asymmetry explicitly.
supplemental_comparison: Previously tested graph solve_ex, graph Cholesky, graph inverse and compiled graph MVDR are retained as supplemental optimized references. No deliberate slowing or recomputation of irrelevant work in standard references.
setup: Graph capture/compilation and model loading excluded from steady-state latency, recorded separately
test_role: Existing 12000-scene holdout is reused only for deployment numerical/metric regression after implementation selection on development data
